Magic Jewelry.name: Magic Jewelry
Magic Jewelry.summary: Magic Jewelry is a tile-matching puzzle video game for the NES. It was programmed by Hwang Shinwei in Taiwan and released in 1990 by RCM, without a license from Nintendo.

Ninja Gaiden III - The Ancient Ship of D.name: Ninja Gaiden III: The Ancient Ship of Doom
Ninja Gaiden III - The Ancient Ship of D.summary: Thrilling new cinema screen! Follow the story of Ryu's epic adventure through Tecmo's movie-like Cinema Screen Animation. As you complete each level, a new part of the story unfolds. Exciting new powers and weapons! Over the years Ninja Ryu's fighting skills have improved to include fantastic new powers and weapons. Action-packed Ninja adventure! Can you get Ryu through his most challenging adventure as he battles the hideous ancient forces of darkness to save mankind? The Ultimate Ninja Challenge!
